description: NYC building footprints is the City of New York's open dataset of footprint outlines of buildings across the five boroughs, published on NYC Open Data with attribution to the Office of Technology and Innovation. The current dataset, named BUILDING, was created in November 2024 and published in May 2025; its rows were last updated in September 2026, and it has been viewed more than 52,000 times and downloaded more than 9,000 times. Documentation of fields is kept in the city's nyc-geo-metadata repository, and related feature services are listed on the NYC Maps hub. Coverage: New York City. Access: table, export and API through NYC Open Data. Licence: NYC Open Data terms of use; free. Caveats: field definitions, including height and construction year, should be checked in the metadata document, and an older footprint dataset identifier no longer resolves. Simulation uses are building-level exposure for coastal flood, heat and wind studies and a geometry base for city energy and digital twin models. Related records: NYC PLUTO and the Local Law 84 benchmarking data where written.
